children: GREEN BAY, Wis., Sept. 16, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Associated Banc-Corp (
), the holding company for Associated Bank, N.A., announced today it has increased the bank's prime rate to 7.00 percent from 6.75 percent, effective September 17, 2026.

) has total assets of approximately $52 billion and is the largest bank holding company based in Wisconsin. Headquartered in Green Bay, Wisconsin, Associated is a leading Midwest banking franchise, offering a full range of financial products and services from over 200 banking locations throughout Wisconsin, Illinois, Iowa, Minnesota, Missouri and Nebraska. The Company also operates loan production offices in Indiana, Kansas, Michigan, New York, Ohio and Texas. Associated Bank, N.A. is an Equal Housing Lender, Equal Opportunity Lender and Member FDIC.
